items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: So many of them I worked with... George Fields

ctx.x: The trombone players, which trombone Players do you remember that you enjoyed working with?

There you are again. Poor me, (unintelligible). So many of them I worked with a lot of good ones and a lot of bad ones. You know. I got to give all -- old Red the devil, which belongs to him. Ory, and I got to give Eddie Atkins, I got to give Honore Dutrey -- I'm calling trombone players. George Fields --

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Then when I was at the Dreamland, I went to Wake Down and Peekin for Dan Jackson, and I used to have Manuel, Teo, Frankie Enya, see, and, uh, Eddie Atkins on some bones. ... George Fields was with Manuel.

ctx.x: Then the next band went, Big Eye Lewy. He come along. Big Eye Lewy was with Freddie and, uh, and-and-and-and George Backe was with, uh, And, uh, George Fields was with Manuel. Then when I was at the Dreamland, I went to Wake Down and Peekin for Dan Jackson, and I used to have Manuel, Teo, Frankie Enya, see, and, uh, Eddie Atkins on some bones.
